You can sell your album as a digital download through our platform. Here’s how it works:

1. Set the Price: Choose the price for your digital album.
2. Receive orders: When a user purchases your song, you will receive a notification with the order details in your profile under the sales section.
3. Send the Content: You’ll need to provide the buyer with high-quality audio and video files, along with a personalized message.
4. Exclusive Content (Optional): You can also include exclusive content, such as previews of your next release, discounts on future purchases, or even tickets to your upcoming concerts.

Important Note:

You’re only selling the audio and video files; no royalties, licenses, or ownership rights to the song are included.
 Selling digital downloads is optional; you can choose to upload only the video without offering the audio file for sale.

Sell your song as an NFT. You can choose to sell just one unit to make it unique and therefore more expensive, or create multiple units at a more accessible price. The strategy is up to you.

Keep in mind that the buyer only gets the NFT and does not receive any rights or royalties associated with the music. The buyer will not own the song itself but will be a collector of your work, signed on the blockchain by you.

Also, make sure to include a link that directs to the Smusix marketplace; otherwise, your video may be removed.
